title: Deadpool box light on items but still worth the cost
text:
The deadpool riding a unicorn makes this box well worth it! While there weren't many items (and no tshirt) I do feel that the retail value of the included items is more than what I paid for the box and add in the convenience of not having to search around for the fun little items and the enjoyment of getting a "surprise" in the mail and...yeah, personally I think it's worth it. Will I use or keep it all? Nope, the taco holder is a bit lame, I'll probably see if a friend can use it and I may add the key chain or luggage tag to an upcoming birthday or Christmas gift. I'm good with that because again I have something fun to give away without having to search around.

But the deadpool on the unicorn is mine. All mine! Love that thing!
label: positive
